BALOCHISTAN MINING CONCESSION RULES, 1970
BALOCHISTAN MINING CONCESSION RULES, 1970
(Addition of R.65 A)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 24th August, 1994]
No.S.O.(MR)4‑6/94.3502‑4, dated 24‑10‑1994.‑‑In
exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Regulation of Mines and
Oil‑Fields and Mineral Development (Government Control) Act, 1948 (XXIV
of 1948), the Government of Balochistan is pleased to add the following new
rule after rule 65 of the Balochistan Mining Concession Rules, 1970, namely:‑‑
"65‑A. The Government may collect royalty on
all or any minerals, in any mining area in Balochistan for a specific period
through contractors by holding open auction from time. The procedure in this
behalf shall be prescribed through a notification by the Government."
